components.selection_alpha: sum_i w_i * (r_i - beta_i * r_bench): did the names chosen beat their market exposure
components.beta_gap: (sum_i w_i * beta_i - 1) * r_bench: exposure above/below one benchmark unit
components.sizing: sum_i (w_actual_i - w_artifact_i) * r_i: the cost of not holding the decided weights
components.timing: entry/exit price vs the close convention the artifact was priced at
components.cash_drag: w_cash_actual * (r_bench - r_cash): the disease this allocator exists to make visible
components.execution: fills vs marks (spread, partial fills, venue refusals -- the opg 13/15 shape)
components.risk_interventions: dollar delta of stops/gates that fired vs the artifact's intent (S34: stops fired on BETA; this line is where that shows)
